# How to Change an Outfit in an Image with Claude MCP and Medux

Claude MCP tutorial for changing clothing in an image with Medux using a person photo, outfit reference, upload URLs, task polling, and final generated image download.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_image_outfit_swap`

## Prompt

```text
Use the connected Medux tools to change the outfit of the person in the attached SOURCE_IMAGE to match the clothing in the attached OUTFIT_REFERENCE. Preserve identity, pose, body proportions, and background. Show me both uploaded file IDs and the outfit-swap arguments, then wait for my approval. After approval, monitor the task and return the completed image.
```

## Review before approval

- Every local file or attachment maps to the intended Medux file or asset ID.
- The proposed tool names match the live Medux MCP schema.
- Operation order, output settings, and cost-relevant options match the request.

## Claude notes

- In claude.ai or Claude Desktop, attach inputs and enable the Medux connector for the conversation.
- In Claude Code, keep inputs in the working directory and confirm Medux with `/mcp`.
- An attachment is not a Medux `file_id`; approve the upload step when the workflow requires one.
